name: maker-face-select-tangent-connected
about: Right-click the plate's front side face › Select › Tangent connected faces: the 8 side faces (4 planes, 4 R8 cylinders); then Fillet with them preselected (its Entities to fillet field); Escape
source: lead 11-27: the maker flow (the user's own: a part with filleted / spline outlines, a sketch on its face, Use, Offset, chain selection, dimensions and constraints to used geometry, Extrude, Fillet of tangent chains)
